name: "Hoshi no Zanzou" ~Kehaizaka Jogakukan no Kinki~
original_name: 『星の残像』～化粧坂女学館の禁忌～
source:
The Maiden's Academy, Kewaizaka Girls' School.
Saya Karenuma transferred here to search for her "big sister," Sana Shizuki, who vanished ten years ago.
Saya slips into the school at night, all the while chasing answers surrounded by classmates tormented by erotic nightmares.
Everyone—students and teachers alike—sees echoes of Sana in Saya and acts weird around her.
It's like everyone's reliving some old scandal; one after another, the girls start to lose it.
Can Saya uncover the secret behind that disappearance? When morning comes, will she finally grasp the truth?

[Translated from [url=https://granat.sakura.ne.jp/novel/zanzou.html]granat.sakura.ne.jp[/url]]
translation:
少女们的学园——化妆坂女学馆。
为了寻找10年前失踪的“姐姐”志筑纱奈，枯沼纱耶转入了这里。
身边的同学们正被带有情欲色彩的噩梦折磨，而纱耶为了追查真相，悄悄潜入了夜晚的校园。
无论学生还是教师，都仿佛在她身上看见了纱奈的影子，态度也变得古怪起来。
往日的丑闻仿佛再次上演，少女们接连陷入疯狂。
纱耶能否揭开失踪事件的秘密？当清晨到来，她能否终于触及真相？

[译自[url=https://granat.sakura.ne.jp/novel/zanzou.html]granat.sakura.ne.jp[/url]]
